'''2008 New York State Championship Jeremy Knapp LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy Knapp]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' DBO/MDTYR
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
